item: Full lists behind the eight pattern Leads, corpus-wide Who, and undo for dismissed cards and hidden keywords (R685)
key_paths: src/static/app-patterns.js; src/static/app-home.js; src/static/app-insights.js; src/static/index.html; src/api/insights.py; src/api/signals.py; src/static/locales/*.json
summary: Twelve routes Lane M found with no button now have one. A Lead's back and Insights > Patterns open the full list for copied wording, flooded topic, headline vs body, sudden emergence, recycled claim, source laundering, disputed chronology and story propagation; Insights > Who lists people and organisations with counts. Items say what was measured, never a verdict; each count line says how many and when (computed_at stamped inside the cached compute) with the caveat visible under it and a How this was measured button beside it for the method and thresholds (R685 as corrected). The dismiss toast undoes (briefing/restore), the Briefing header brings all dismissed cards back (dismissed/clear), a hidden keyword has its Undo (insights/include). 48 strings x12, non-English AI-drafted.
